decisions.reason: As an organic line extension close to the core charcuterie range, it is inexpensive to keep as an option and there is not yet enough negative market evidence from its first year to justify withdrawal.
This product fits both the firm's strategic push into organic offerings and its existing processing know-how, so real-options logic favors keeping it on the market while demand uncertainty resolves.

Given industry growth, the firm's broad assortment strategy, and the product's close fit with established salami capabilities, it is reasonable to keep this premium snack option open for another period.
